title: Godiva/Jezebel bare-critical-sphere k_eff V&V
description: Bare critical sphere k_eff for U-235 Godiva / U-233 Jezebel. Uses nu-bar(E) (MF=1/452) + fission spectrum chi(E->E') (MF=5) read straight off ENDF by njoy::nuclear_data::secondary, handed to openmc-libs::Nuclide. See crates/openmc-libs/docs/validation.md.

title: BROADR SIGMA1 + U-238 capture wing-pedestal fix
description: SIGMA1 free-gas kernel ported (rayon-parallel per point). Fixed the U-238 capture wing pedestal: root cause was RECONR grid coarseness (over-linearized wings), not SIGMA1 — added reconr::refine_resonance_grid (adaptive bisection to tolerance). RRR L1 vs OpenMC 0.30 -> 0.0007 at 900/1200 K.
close_reason: Fixed 2026-07-07 (RECONR grid density; SIGMA1 unchanged). RRR L1 0.30->0.0007.

title: RECONR: all 5 resolved-resonance formalisms parse + reconstruct (LRF=1/2/3/4/7)
description: SLBW/MLBW (LRF=1/2), Reich-Moore (LRF=3), Adler-Adler (LRF=4, via reconr::aa), R-matrix-limited (LRF=7, via crate::samm). SLBW/MLBW/RM verified (Godiva/Jezebel k-eff + U-238 Doppler). LRF=4/7 wired; verification tracked separately.
close_reason: Done and verified (SLBW/MLBW/RM); LRF=4/7 verification tracked in op-cjw.5 / op-cjw.2.

title: Port ERRORR (multigroup covariance, ~11.2k lines)
description: Next major NJOY module. Largest single file in the port so far. Also the real caller that enables SAMM's Want_Partial_Derivs / Want_Angular_Dist, so it unblocks the deferred SAMM derivative + angular routines.
notes: Active priority 2026-07-08: porting NJOY forward (ERRORR) is the current focus for the njoy crate.

title: Verify SAMM (LRF=7 R-matrix limited) end-to-end
description: All 6 SAMM phases translated for the RECONR-reachable (KRM=3/IFG=0, no derivatives/angular) core and wired into RECONR (reconr::add_rml_range). NOT run against a real LRF=7 evaluation (16O / 19F). Opus verification: reconstruct an LRF=7 nuclide and reproduce reference NJOY pointwise sigma(E).

title: SAMM mf2 eliminated-channel reorder index: gamma(igamma+1) vs derived igamma-1
description: In samm::mf2, the eliminated-capture-channel reorder reads gamma(igamma+1) (samm.f90:1186); three independent hand-derivations predicted igamma-1, with a worked example showing igamma+1 reads past the group's valid channel range. Ported literally + bounds-checked + flagged. Highest-priority thing to check against a real LRF=7 evaluation where the eliminated channel isn't first.

title: njoy-outram-park-fork — nuclear data (NJOY2016 Rust port)
description: All nuclear data: NJOY2016 ENDF port (RECONR/BROADR/THERMR/ACER/HEATR/GASPR/UNRESR/PURR/SAMM), Faddeeva, windowed-multipole, lean-ACE + WMP blobs, nu-bar/chi. Exposes the XsProvider surface other crates pull from. GPL-3.0.

title: openmc-libs — Monte Carlo transport (data-free)
description: CSG geometry, particle tracking, k-eigenvalue, Woodcock delta-tracking. Data-free: pulls cross sections from njoy-outram-park-fork. Godiva/Jezebel k-eff V&V. GPL-3.0.

title: XsProvider wiring: openmc-libs pulls all cross sections from njoy
description: Data-free transport: openmc-libs consumes njoy-outram-park-fork via the XsProvider surface. Track completeness of the provider API vs transport needs (continuous-energy + URR self-shielding once PURR is verified).

title: Choked-flow (HEM) multiphase critical-flow solvers
description: Unified dispatcher + in-dome / subcooled / superheated-vapour solvers, validated vs Moody(1975), Zaloudek, Marviken. All stagnation buckets + the near-bubble-point x~0 artifact fixed. Only known discrepancy: isobar_pref_0_25 (p0=1.72 bar) #[ignore]d (IAPWS isentrope vs incompressible-Bernoulli at extreme pressure ratio).
close_reason: All three stagnation-bucket solvers validated; near-bubble-point x~0 artifact fixed. Sole outstanding point tracked as op-21g.2.

title: SAMM derivatives + angular distributions (deferred to ERRORR)
description: babb / derres / derext (derivatives) and angle / lmaxxx / kclbsch / clbsch / setleg (angular). Unreachable from RECONR (it hardcodes both flags off); build alongside ERRORR, their real caller. Per the no-orphaned-dead-code rule.

title: Verify Adler-Adler (LRF=4) reconstruction
description: reconr::aa + parse_adler_adler ported (all 5 resolved formalisms LRF=1/2/3/4/7 now parse+reconstruct). Record layout reconstructed from reconr.f90 rdf2aa/csaa (no ENDF-102 excerpt locally). Two upstream oddities ported literally + flagged in aa.rs (background scaled by C/sqrt(E) twice; LI==6 redefines total). Not yet run against a real Adler-Adler evaluation.

title: Verify URR: UNRESR + PURR (incl. unrest Monte Carlo core)
description: UNRESR + PURR fully ported module-for-module (2026-07-06), genuinely NOT run even once. Suggested Opus verification order in src/purr/README.md: RNG exact-match, uw2/DopplerTable agreement, line_shape tier boundaries, then full pipeline. Unblocks self-shielding + the U-238 20-149 keV unresolved band.

title: nee_soon — integration / coupling layer
description: Human-readable integration/coupling layer: composes MC (openmc-libs) + deterministic/TH + nuclear data (njoy) + PRKE, exposes CFD-coupling interfaces. See docs/architecture.md. Status: populate backlog from crate README/docs.

title: tuas_boussinesq_solver — thermal-hydraulics (Boussinesq single-phase)
description: TUAS single-phase Boussinesq thermal-hydraulics solver. GPL-3.0. Status: populate backlog from crate README/docs.

title: teh-o-prke — Point Reactor Kinetics (PRKE)
description: Point Reactor Kinetics for the Teh-O transport/eigenvalue solver. GPL-3.0. Status: populate backlog from crate README/docs.

title: openfoam-basic-lib — OpenFOAM primitive + FV layer (Layers 1-4)
description: Pure-Rust translation of OpenFOAM primitive + finite-volume layer: tensor algebra, polynomial/ODE solvers, interpolation, thermophysics kernels, fields, mesh, FV operators, fluid/solid thermo. GPL-3.0.

title: tampines-steam-tables — IAPWS-IF97 + steam turbine + choked flow
description: In-house IAPWS-IF97 steam/water properties with uom units, steam-turbine + converging-diverging nozzle equations incl. choked (HEM) two-phase flow, FHR secondary-loop simulator. GPL-3.0.

title: Move GUI/tuas FHR sim examples into a new 'tampines' app crate
description: Planned: move fhr_sim_v1/v2 (egui GUI + tuas dev-dep) out of tampines-steam-tables into a dedicated tampines app crate so the library stays TUAS-free. See memory 'planned-tampines-app-crate'.

title: Tighten U-238 Doppler RRR-L1 gate now the wing bug is fixed
description: tests/u238_doppler_verification currently gates only finiteness + <5% above-RRR and reports RRR L1. Post-fix RRR L1 is ~0.0007 at 900/1200 K. Convert to a hard gate (mind the CI timeout; the test reconstructs U-238 twice).

title: File-size splits: heatr/mod.rs (1363), wmp.rs (1276), purr/mod.rs (1079)
description: Crate rule: no source file over 1000 lines (1500 max), split by function into a module_name/ dir. These three predate the rule; split opportunistically when next touched. Tracked in docs/porting-plan.md §5.

title: boon-lay — Lagrangian decay / TRISO release simulator
description: Lagrangian decay simulator (single-particle Monte Carlo, CRP-6 release-fraction cases) + TRISO simulator + egui GUI examples. Status: populate backlog from crate README/docs.

title: chem-eng-real-time-process-control-simulator — PID / transfer-function control
description: PID / transfer-function process-control library for real-time simulators. Apache-2.0 (the workspace's only Apache crate). Status: populate backlog from crate README/docs.

title: dwsim-libs — (chemical-process modelling libs)
description: DWSIM-derived chemical-process libraries. Status: role + backlog to be populated from crate README/docs (not yet surveyed in detail).

title: openfoam-turbulence-lib — turbulence models
description: Turbulence model registry/kernels layered on openfoam-basic-lib (enum-dispatched TurbulenceModel per workspace design rules). Status: populate backlog from crate README/docs.

title: openfoam-appbuilder-lib — solver/app builder + GenFOAM host
description: Layer-5 solver-loop composition (PISO/PIMPLE, multi-region coupling) and the future in-crate home for GenFOAM deterministic + TH. Status: populate backlog from crate README/docs.

title: fhr_sim_v2 UI state-update bug
description: Known UI state-update bug in the fhr_sim_v2 example; see tampines docs/notes.md.

title: Moody isobar_pref_0_25 deep-subcooled point (#[ignore]d)
description: Sole deeply-subcooled data point fails |Δlog10 G|=0.170 because IAPWS-IF97 isentrope diverges from the incompressible-Bernoulli limit at p_bubble/p0~0.02. Documented HEM limitation; ignored. Low priority.

title: Not started: GROUPR / GAMINR / COVR / LEAPR
description: Multigroup neutron/photon XS (GROUPR), multigroup photon interaction (GAMINR), covariance output/plotting (COVR), S(alpha,beta) generation (LEAPR). Future/low priority; OUTRAM PARK's OpenMC ACE path does not require them.

title: Resonance windowing for the fissile reconstruction path (perf)
description: After the adaptive resonance-grid fix, the fissile 3x3-fission-matrix Reich-Moore path (U-235) is slow on the ~20x denser grid (strains the test timeout even rayon-parallel). Port NJOY-style resonance windowing (skip resonances whose tail is negligible at E) into reconr::rm/slbw/aa; validate it does not erode the between-resonance background the U-238 L1=0.0007 depends on.
notes: Deferred by user 2026-07-08: the adaptive-refinement + windowing interplay is considered new and research-worthy; the fissile-path speedup will be done manually much later. Current priority is porting NJOY modules (ERRORR next), not perf.
